extraction.notes: Quarter ended Sept 30, 2022 column (third numeric column). EQR has no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. FFO and Normalized FFO are reconciled from Net income through the 'available to Common Shares and Units' subtotals (FFO 349,866; Normalized 356,667), because the per-share figures are based on those; the 'Preferred distributions' line (-773) is therefore included in ffo_adjustments with category 'other'. The intermediate 'FFO' (350,639) and 'Normalized FFO' (357,440) subtotals before preferred distributions are not used as totals. Impairment – non-operating assets is printed as '—' (zero). Net (gain) loss on sales of unconsolidated entities is '—' (zero). Categorization of 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (156) is uncertain; recorded as 'other'. Diluted shares 389,300 reproduces diluted FFO/share 0.90 and Normalized 0.92. Recurring capex: the only capex table (page 24) covers nine months YTD (Replacements 30,733 / Capital Expenditures to Real Estate 141,707), with no current-quarter figure, and no AFFO line exists, so null.
